title: Concept: Dynamic code evaluation via instance_eval in ruby — review required
description: In ruby, instance_eval receives a string. Unlike the block form, the string is compiled by the interpreter, so interpolation or concatenation of request data yields arbitrary code execution inside the object context. The receiver context also exposes private methods that ordinary public dispatch would not reach.
applicability: ruby applications that evaluate DSL fragments or user-authored expressions.
risk: Arbitrary Ruby execution with application privileges; HIGH severity.
